item.title: Maths notes (1)
item.description: So I started reading a paper about diffusion (the original DDPM paper) and I was quickly out of my depth. I needed a refresher about probabilities, and actually even more basic stuff like exponential and integration. And I thought why not share the notes here! So this blog post is the content of a python notebook about exponential and the normal distribution, exported to markdown with jupyter nbconvert. It’s not deep or anything, just a nice refresher for myself. Kind of a pain to write math formulas and get them displayed in my Jekyll blog but got it working with Mathjax.
